title:
PROPORTION,
(INVERSE PROPORTION)
objective: LO: I can solve problems involving inverse proportion.

content.text: Two quantities are inversely proportional if when one doubles, the other halves. Their product stays constant.
Formula: y = &frac{k}{x} where k is constant. As x increases, y decreases.

examples.expr: y = &frac{k}{x} means y is inversely proportional to x
If 4 workers take 6 hours, 2 workers take 12 hours
If 4 workers take 6 hours, 8 workers take 12 hours

key_idea.title: Key idea
key_idea.text: In inverse proportion, the product xy is always constant. y = k ÷ x.
key_idea.caption: k = x × y (constant product), x↑ means y↓

modelled_examples.label: Example 1 – workers and time
modelled_examples.question: 4 builders take 15 days to build a wall. How long for 6 builders?
modelled_examples.explanation: More workers means less time: inverse proportion.

modelled_examples.label: Example 2 – finding k
modelled_examples.question: y is inversely proportional to x. When x = 3, y = 8. Find y when x = 6.
modelled_examples.explanation: Find the constant product, then divide.

modelled_examples.label: Example 3 – speed and time
modelled_examples.question: At 60 mph, a journey takes 2 hours. How long at 40 mph?
modelled_examples.explanation: Speed and time are inversely proportional for a fixed distance.

modelled_examples.label: Example 4 – inverse square
modelled_examples.question: y is inversely proportional to x². When x = 2, y = 5. Find y when x = 4.
modelled_examples.explanation: Inversely proportional to x² means y = k/x².
